methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Audit the dirty-state restoration boundary of PR #3697's mixed-negative Q8 attainment witnesses for t <= 2, with an exact negative control that passes a diagonal-only endpoint check but fails the complete matrix check.
scope_change_reason: The assigned task narrows the broad new-register card to one current Q8 handoff and one restoration boundary; it does not repeat a word search or lower-bound derivation.
bottleneck_link: Formal side result for the bit-new-register-model card. It checks whether the proposed per-call endpoint really preserves arbitrary dirty spectator coordinates; it adds no physical saving or kappa claim.
stop_rule: Stop when the diagonal coordinate-projector witnesses pass exact full-matrix replay and the legal leaking control is rejected by that full-matrix predicate but accepted by the diagonal-only predicate.
evidence: verify.py passed with Python 3.12 in normal and optimized mode. It checked 24 exact full-matrix cases: all six t=1 or t=2 negative-Q8 target types with zero through three extra roles. The exact 3-call rank-one leaking control has diagonal ([zi],[1]) and lower-left [1]+[zi]; for each of the eight Q8 dirty basis symbols, its core output matches while the spectator output differs. The mathematical diagonal-projector identity gives arbitrary spectator count. The selected-result orientation command passed PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY.
